decision_text: The owner explicitly accepted the complete HTML review board shown for the G4 Segmentation family. Acceptance covers UI-SEG-001 in all six required states, the three responsive-Web anchors, the visible isolated actions, Result Trust, and applicable pilot visual-language inheritance. It does not authorize production implementation, publication, deployment, mobile-specific design, another G4 family, G5, G6, or full WCAG conformance.
